Author: Serpens66
Name: Active AIV Detector
Description: Diagnostic mod that logs the lord and AIVJSON selected by the native castle placement engine.

Changes: Updated the mod for Script Extender 2.2.0.
Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Support Steam build 24816905 after validating the native AIV, player, organism, and placement layouts.
Resolve the placement validator from a stable interior signature and expose an optional managed observer so compatible mods can share the native detour.
Use locally validated reference RVAs instead of full native signature scans on the supported DLL.
Add an opt-in synchronous ExecuteBuildStep trace with per-frame return values and complete BuildingId-grid differences.
Reuse and validate the placement-state pointer observed by the native validator while preserving all Vanilla results and state.
Capture at most one wildcard trace per player and write a separate live-building-grid snapshot for every captured player.
Read the full live-building-grid snapshot from the placement-state pointer observed by the native validator instead of the unrelated AIV state.
Capture advopt_pre_build before the skirmish starts and include the session-bound value in every Oracle record and trace.
Add an opt-in full live-building-grid snapshot for distinguishing map, start-complex, and realized Sofortspawn occupancy.
Add an opt-in, exactly filtered post-fit cell trace for the native mapper, score, and result grids.
Record unchanged generic-validator results only while the filtered fit call is active.
Include the live native tile fields, organism class, and game mode used by each traced validator call.
Write traced cells to a separate CRLF TSV file without changing Vanilla candidate evaluation.
Report the loaded map file's SHA-256 in every native placement-oracle selection and attempt for reproducible offline comparisons.
Add a passive native oracle for every Vanilla AIV candidate and rotation fit test.
Log raw fit score, fit percentage, evaluated and blocked cells, map identity, placement anchor, and final placement state without changing game state.
Bundle all vanilla AIVJSON files from the official Castle and CPU Lord Editor.
Report the concrete bundled vanilla AIVJSON path and SHA-256 while distinguishing it from the embedded data actually used by the game.
Report the concrete bundled vanilla lordjson corresponding to an embedded default AIC.
Verify bundled vanilla AIC exports against the installed CrusaderDE.dll SHA-256 and distinguish equivalent exports from files actually read by the game.
Distinguish the logical base lord from temporary SK_X1 through SK_X8 runtime slots.
Report the selected custom lordjson path and checksum when an Extended Lord configuration is active.
Use the runtime AILords enum's Int32 backing type when validating captured lord IDs.
Keep reporting finalized selections even if source metadata resolution fails for one player.
Capture the lobby lord and AIV source list before a skirmish starts.
Resolve the native candidate ID to custom AIV names and paths or equivalent vanilla editor filenames.
Report effective Script Extender AIV asset overrides when present.
Buffer final native AIV selections until OnStartMap(Post) confirms the map has fully started.
Report selections only for active AI player slots and use Info logging for normal diagnostics.
Detect the final native AIV selection for every AI player.
Log candidate ID, orientation, placement result, AI type, and AIVSpec index with millisecond timestamps.
